sloka: आविकं विविधं चौर्णं काञ्चनं भाण्डमायुधम्।नानाविकृतसंस्थानं वाजिभाण्डपरिच्छदौ ।। ६.७५.९ ।।
transliteration: āvikaṁ vividhaṁ caurṇaṁ kāñcanaṁ bhāṇḍamāyudham।nānāvikṛtasaṁsthānaṁ vājibhāṇḍaparicchadau ।। 6.75.9 ।।

translations.english: Their white linen and beautiful silks were burnt. Nay, even several blankets of wool, chests and weapons were also burnt.
